_comment: Hand-written extras for every endpoint, keyed by '<product> <METHOD> <path>'. Names, actions and descriptions otherwise come from the OpenAPI specs. Keys: records (required for every endpoint: true if the endpoint returns real pipeline records, which must not leave the customer's region, so it must then also be excluded; the build fails for an endpoint without it, so a spec sync can't ship an unreviewed endpoint), name (endpoint name), action (read, write or delete), destructive (a write that loses or re-ingests data), consequence (one line on the effect of the change, shown to agents and in the approval prompt), title (the change as the approval prompt names it: 'Delete Edge Destination'; '{}' marks where the resource id goes, as in 'Run Standard Pipeline {} now', otherwise it goes last), description (text prepended to the spec description), exclude (true drops the endpoint), approval (always, never or unless_activating: whether the server asks the user to approve each call; writes default to always, reads to never, and deletes are always), body_required (top-level request body keys that Hevo requires though its spec leaves them optional; the build adds them to the body's required list, so the spec stays as fetched).

edge PATCH /api/v2/destinations/{destina.title: Update Edge Destination
edge PATCH /api/v2/destinations/{destina.consequence: Affects every Pipeline that loads data into this Destination. If the credentials are incorrect, these Pipelines cannot load data.

edge DELETE /api/v2/destinations/{destin.title: Delete Edge Destination
edge DELETE /api/v2/destinations/{destin.consequence: Deletes this Destination and every Pipeline that loads data into it. This action cannot be undone.

edge PATCH /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_i.title: Update settings of Edge Pipeline
edge PATCH /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_i.consequence: Changes the settings of this Pipeline, such as its schedule or how it loads data. A new schedule applies from the next run.

edge DELETE /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_.title: Delete Edge Pipeline
edge DELETE /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_.consequence: Deletes this Pipeline. The tables in the Destination are not deleted. This action cannot be undone.

edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.title: Disable Edge Pipeline
edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.consequence: The Pipeline stops reading data from the Source and loading it into the Destination. Jobs that are running finish, unless the request cancels them.

edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.title: Enable Edge Pipeline
edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.consequence: The Pipeline starts reading data from the Source and loading it into the Destination.

edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.title: Resync Edge Pipeline
edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.consequence: Reloads all the data from the Source. If the request asks to re-create the tables, the tables in the Destination are deleted and created again.

edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.title: Sync Edge Pipeline {} now
edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.consequence: Starts a Pipeline run. The data that it reads from the Source counts toward your Events quota.

edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.title: Cancel job of Edge Pipeline
edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.consequence: Stops the tasks of this job that are running.

edge PATCH /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_i.title: Include, exclude, or update objects of Edge Pipeline
edge PATCH /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_i.consequence: Hevo stops ingesting the data of excluded objects.

edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.title: Resync objects of Edge Pipeline
edge POST /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id.consequence: Reloads the data of these objects from the Source. If the request asks to re-create their tables, the tables are deleted and created again.

edge PATCH /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_i.title: Update Source of Edge Pipeline
edge PATCH /api/v2/pipelines/{pipeline_i.consequence: If the Source credentials are incorrect, the Pipeline cannot read data from the Source.

account POST /api/public/v2.0/accounts/u.name: invite_user
account POST /api/public/v2.0/accounts/u.title: Invite user to team
account POST /api/public/v2.0/accounts/u.consequence: Gives the invited user access to your Hevo account.

account POST /api/public/v2.0/accounts/u.name: invite_user_with_roles
account POST /api/public/v2.0/accounts/u.description: Roles: PIPELINE_COLLABORATOR, PIPELINE_ADMIN, ACTIVATION_COLLABORATOR, ACTIVATION_ADMIN, MODELS_AND_WORKFLOWS_COLLABORATOR, MODELS_AND_WORKFLOWS_ADMIN, BILLING_ADMIN, TEAM_COLLABORATOR, TEAM_ADMIN, or OBSERVER. Any other value returns a 400.
account POST /api/public/v2.0/accounts/u.title: Invite user to team with roles
account POST /api/public/v2.0/accounts/u.consequence: Gives the invited user access to your Hevo account with the given roles.

account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.name: update_user_role
account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.description: Sets the team role, MEMBER or OWNER, shown as role in list_users. OWNER transfers the team's ownership to this user, and only the team owner can do that (403 otherwise). Roles that grant access to Pipelines, Models or billing are set with update_user_roles.
account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.title: Change role of user {}
account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.consequence: Changes what this user can access in Hevo; OWNER transfers the team's ownership to this user.

account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.name: update_user_roles
account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.description: Roles: PIPELINE_COLLABORATOR, PIPELINE_ADMIN, ACTIVATION_COLLABORATOR, ACTIVATION_ADMIN, MODELS_AND_WORKFLOWS_COLLABORATOR, MODELS_AND_WORKFLOWS_ADMIN, BILLING_ADMIN, TEAM_COLLABORATOR, TEAM_ADMIN, or OBSERVER. Any other value returns a 400.
account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.title: Change roles of user {}
account PUT /api/public/v2.0/accounts/us.consequence: Changes what this user can access in Hevo.

account DELETE /api/public/v2.0/accounts.name: delete_user
account DELETE /api/public/v2.0/accounts.title: Remove user {} from team
account DELETE /api/public/v2.0/accounts.consequence: Removes the user's access to your Hevo account.

account DELETE /api/public/v2.0/accounts.name: delete_oauth_account
account DELETE /api/public/v2.0/accounts.title: Delete OAuth account
account DELETE /api/public/v2.0/accounts.consequence: Every Pipeline that uses this OAuth account can no longer connect to its Source until you authorize another account.
